architecture: One always-on source coordinator, two always-on local agents (source and receiver), each instantiated with real reset_entry and two protected domain-start adapters. Five ordered phases, no operation/context-arm input. Coordinator owns epoch24 and sequence24 and refuses wrap.
management_transport: Four actual W72/AW3 protected FIFOs provide independent-clock command/ACK transport (one command and one ACK per agent). They use always-on management POR only, never endpoint session reset. Source and destination POR assertion must belong to one cold management reset generation; two-edge local release should be supplied by reset_entry. Vendor physical/framing transport beyond these digital crossings remains explicit and must preserve finite atomic valid-ready frames.
credit_transport: Grant/ACK credit transport is a separate lifecycle from management transport: it must be empty before graceful session reset and flushed by coordinated endpoint/PHY reset. The component fixture uses identical protected FIFO hardware for it; no vendor PHY claim.
initial_ack_provider: Source wrapper contains actual protected initial ACK observer on source ACK valid&&ready. Receiver must instantiate ot_hbm_initial_credit_ack_observer on producer ACK input valid&&ready. Observer checks kind41, current epoch, seq0, count64 and sets protected sticky state. Reset observer with that credit endpoint. AND observer seen for every session port. These are not timing-derived flags.
debt_provider: ot_hbm_credit_source_session wraps immutable source with protected debt observer, exposing debt_zero and initial_ack_seen. Observation allow gates external ready AND original source valid BEFORE reserve/grant effects. Actual reserve adds one; fresh returngrant removes its count; initialgrant excluded; duplicates never decrement twice; CE stalls rather than dropping observations. Source debt includes unsent retained reservations and all forward flight until corresponding retired credit returns.
quiet_binding: Bind agent reserved_debt_zero to actual source wrapper debt_zero for all session source ports. Native quiet_core/quiet_phy, data_flight_empty and credit_control_empty must independently cover all payload/CDC held heads, actual PHY flights and old grant/ACK transport. Receiver local agent also needs its actual local drain obligations. No synthetic constant quiet gate may establish native admission.

phase_contracts.QUIESCE: Stop new source reservations. Continue already reserved launches until debt and all native queues/flight/control transport drain. Assert PHY quiesce request and require explicit PHY quiesced acknowledgment; require reset ACK low before requesting new reset.
phase_contracts.RESET: Both agents assert actual local endpoint reset_entry and PHY reset request; wait explicit PHY reset ACK, preserved quiet/drain, and observed low local resets. Vendor ACK must attest physical quarantine/purge, not elapsed cycles.
phase_contracts.RELEASE: Coordinator advances epoch after both reset ACKs. Agent receives new protected epoch then releases reset_entry; wait both local reset releases, PHY reset ACK low, old initialACK sticky low and start-seen low.
phase_contracts.START: Held request with stable encoded epoch goes through local start adapters; exactly one cold-start pulse in each local stream/link domain per reset. Wait observed seen in both domains.
phase_contracts.RUN: Wait actual initialcreditACK sticky; deassert PHY quarantine and wait PHY quiesced low before local admission. Source reservations cannot precede initial grant ACK. Coordinator running requires both local RUN ACKs.

fault_contract: Local agent UE asserts endpoint reset/quarantine and closes local gates; source wrapper faults close reserve/grant acceptance. Coordinator fault withholds all further management commands and running permission; integration must AND coordinator running/fault and local fault outputs into admission policy and propagate emergency faults across its management provider. A faulted graceful drain cannot be bypassed by assumed timeout purge.

latency: At least20 management frames/1440 encoded bits per full cold generation, plus vendor framing/serialization/flight and management FIFO sync2/capture2/readII3. Local reset release two edges per domain; stable request startup crossing two local edges then one protected pulse. No steady data-path added clean cycle in debt wrapper; added ready gating requires contextual timing. No reset per operation/context.
